name: Dearc
sum: Largest flying animal of its time: a big rhamphorhynchine from the Middle Jurassic of the Isle of Skye, Scotland.
wsnote: Estimated 2.5–3 m; the holotype was still growing (proportional estimates range 1.9–3.8 m).
holotype: NMS G.2021.6.1-4 — Lealt Shale Formation, Trotternish, Isle of Skye.
material: Three-dimensional articulated skeleton missing the tail tip, most hindlimbs, parts of wings and beak tip.
biology: Long fangs at the snout tip and peg-like rear teeth suggest a fish-eater living around Jurassic lagoons.
author: Jagielska et al. 2022
